title: Reconstruction Agreement General Conditions Schedule: Cooling-Off, Cancellation Fee and Restocking
content:
The cancellation figures below are the same on every Reconstruction agreement.

| Agreement | Cooling-off business days | Cooling-off minimum contract amount | Cancellation fee | Special-order restocking |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | 3 | $25.00 | 10% | 25% |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | 3 | $25.00 | 10% | 25% |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | 3 | $25.00 | 10% | 25% |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | 3 | $25.00 | 10% | 25% |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | 3 | $25.00 | 10% | 25% |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | 3 | $25.00 | 10% | 25% |

## Terms used

- **Cooling-off business days**: the business days (every day except Sundays and federal holidays) after signing within which a home-solicitation contract may be cancelled without charge.
- **Cooling-off minimum contract amount**: the contract amount at or above which the cooling-off right applies to a contract signed at the buyer's home, in US dollars.
- **Cancellation fee**: the cancellation fee as a percentage of the contract amount when the customer cancels after the cooling-off period and before construction starts.
- **Special-order restocking**: the restocking charge on special-order materials already ordered when a contract or change order is cancelled, as a percentage of the material cost.

## Illustration with hypothetical figures

A signed contract amount of $18,500.00 at a 10% cancellation fee gives $1850.00; special-order material that cost an assumed $1,200.00 at 25% restocking gives $300.00. A contract amount of $24.99 is below the $25.00 minimum, while $25.00 exactly meets it.
